note: Phase 5 financial layer. Field definitions and the guards enforced by data_p5_finance.validation().
rules: Every rupee figure carries a fiscal year and a source.
Funnel stages are strictly filters of one another and are NEVER summed.
C-05 (the 625x ERP market-sizing conflict) must appear in every output.
BOUNDED figures may never be presented as DOCUMENTED.
Budget headroom is capacity evidence, never willingness evidence. Phase 7's price band is deliberately unchanged on the basis of unspent budget.

conflicts.subject: How many IICs exist in India
conflicts.why_it_matters: A 16% spread across three government sources, none stating a counting rule.
conflicts.our_choice: Report the range 14,067-16,367. Never a single number.

conflicts.subject: Which populations may be added together
conflicts.why_it_matters: These answer three different questions and are NOT nested.
conflicts.our_choice: Model each as a separate funnel stage. Never sum.

conflicts.subject: DPIIT startup count moves fast
conflicts.why_it_matters: 17,009 recognitions in ~4 months. Any denominator decays within a year.
conflicts.our_choice: Every figure carries an as-of date.

conflicts.subject: How many colleges and universities exist
conflicts.why_it_matters: Not a data error - three defensible frames. AISHE counts REGISTERED institutions; IBEF counts a later year on a different collection; NITI counts only affiliates of State Public Universities, which is a subset defined by funding route.
conflicts.our_choice: Use AISHE for registered counts and NITI for the state-public system, always naming the frame. Never mix frames in one calculation.

conflicts.subject: Size of the Indian education ERP market
conflicts.why_it_matters: A 625x disagreement between two research houses on the SAME market in the SAME currency. At least one is measuring something else - possibly India-only vs India+APAC, or software-only vs total.
conflicts.our_choice: Use NEITHER as a denominator. They are recorded to show that published market sizing in this category is unusable, which is itself a reason to build bottom-up from institution counts and budgets - which is what we do.
